name: weekday_successor
description: Name the weekday N (1-3) days after a given weekday, wrapping mod 7. Control repeats the starting weekday.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
D=['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday']
nw={1:'one',2:'two',3:'three'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
    d=random.randrange(7); k=random.choice([1,2,3])
    items.append({"prompt":f"Schedule question: {nw[k]} day{'s' if k>1 else ''} after {D[d]} is","answer":" "+D[(d+k)%7]})
    control.append({"prompt":f"Schedule question: {nw[k]} day{'s' if k>1 else ''} after {D[d]}. Repeat the starting day: it is","answer":" "+D[d]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
